const input = $input.first().json;
let route = String(input.governance_route || '').trim().toLowerCase();

const aliasMap = {
  'lead_capture_agent': 'lead_capture_agent',
  'lead': 'lead_capture_agent',
  'intake': 'lead_capture_agent',
  'review': 'feedback_agent',
  'feedback': 'feedback_agent',
  'follow_up': 'followup_agent',
  'followup': 'followup_agent',
  'quote': 'quote_agent',
  'pricing': 'quote_agent',
  'booking': 'appointment_agent',
  'appointment': 'appointment_agent',
  'sales': 'sales_agent',
  'support': 'support_agent',
  'marketing': 'marketing_agent',
  'whatsapp': 'whatsapp_agent',
  'analytics': 'analytics_agent',
  'governance': 'governance_agent',
  'governance_agent': 'governance_agent',
  'dna': 'dna_steward_agent',
  'dna_steward': 'dna_steward_agent',
  'general_ai_agent': 'general_ai_agent',
  'general': 'general_ai_agent',
  'general_ai': 'general_ai_agent',
  'technical_inquiry': 'general_ai_agent'
};

if (aliasMap[route]) {
  route = aliasMap[route];
}

const allowedRoutes = [
  'sales_agent', 
  'quote_agent', 
  'appointment_agent', 
  'lead_capture_agent',
  'support_agent', 
  'marketing_agent', 
  'followup_agent', 
  'whatsapp_agent',
  'feedback_agent', 
  'analytics_agent', 
  'governance_agent', 
  'dna_steward_agent',
  'general_ai_agent',
  'human_handoff',
  'opt_out'
];

const isAllowed = allowedRoutes.includes(route);
const targetAgent = isAllowed ? (input.selected_agent || input.execution_target || 'General AI Agent') : 'Human Handoff';

return [{
  json: {
    ...input,
    governance_route: route,
    permission_allowed: isAllowed,
    permission_reason: isAllowed ? `Permission granted for ${route}.` : `No permission for ${route}.`,
    execution_target: targetAgent,
    selected_agent: targetAgent,
    execution_status: isAllowed ? 'ready' : 'blocked'
  }
}];

value.name: ={{ $json.name || $json.customer_name }}
value.lead_summary: ={{ $json.lead_summary || (($json.name || $json.customer_name) + ' wants a quote for ' + $json.requested_service + ' (' + ($json.region || 'region not given') + ').') }}
